TorchExtinguishedByWindComment: If true, torches will extinguish due to wind conditions.
TorchExtinguishedByInventoryComment: If true, torches will extinguish when placed in inventory (e.g., backpack).
EnableLogsComment: If true, debug logs will be enabled for the miscellaneous system.
ShowWarningsComment: If true, players will receive a warning message when their torch is extinguished by wind or inventory placement.
